title: High Bay + Low Bay
headline: Replaces up to 1000W HID.
intro: Ultra-bright LED retrofits for high ceiling environments. Models w/o active cooling for open fixtures & silent operation. Models w/ active cooling are safe to install in enclosed fixtures. Low bay retrofits are ideal for ceiling fixtures that require light to be pushed down and out. Angled LED panels help direct light exactly where it is needed.
callouts: Powerful performance – for high bay environments
